rationale: Mandatory reauthentication reportedly discards entered work, and shared-device policy rules out local storage for recovery. The fixture establishes only a blocked state. The proposal keeps the draft locked in volatile memory, restores the editing position only to its authenticated owner, and keeps submission explicit. It identifies the memory-policy assumption and explains when recovery ends. Concrete checks cover account mismatch, accessible retry, in-flight submission status, sensitive-data persistence, and cleanup of unrelated state. The execution events show only reads, and the fixture snapshots match.
